NOTE
**Still not ready**

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ⚠️  | PR description follows the guide: it now has a summary, "Fixes: #19589" and testing notes, but the self-review checklist is not from the PR template and the inline code formatting is broken (stray backslashes) |
| ⚠️  | Testing: the notes say "manually tested" without saying what was sent or what was seen |
| ✅  | Single clean commit (squashed since the feedback), CI passing |
| ℹ️  | Another PR for the same issue (#38098) is still open, and the issue is now assigned to pranjal499. This PR doesn't explain how it relates to either. A similar PR (#38902) was closed for the same reason. |
| ℹ️  | Earlier reviewers asked for the outgoing webhook payload docs to be updated and raised a `python-zulip-api` compatibility question; neither is addressed here |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready", and don't assign a reviewer yet. Ask the author to fix the description and explain how this PR relates to #38098 and the assignment on the issue.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for updating the description! Please replace the self-review checklist with the one from the [PR template](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/reviewable-prs.html), and fix the broken code formatting. Also describe what you manually tested and what you saw, and say how this PR relates to the open #38098 and to the issue now being assigned to someone else.
```
